tables.title: Storage Capacity of the Town Hall

facts: The Town Hall also serves as a resource storage of Gold, Elixir, and Dark Elixir (the latter only when the Town Hall is level 7 or above). Unlike other resource storages, the loot stored in the Town Hall can only be looted if it is destroyed.
